remarks: Bright 3 bedroom, 2 full bath ranch style unit with 9ft ceilings, walk-in closets, private full bath in primary bedroom, access to a balcony from two bedrooms along with an additional bathroom in the hallway. The kitchen overlooks the combo dining room/living room and features granite counters, stainless steel appliances and a center island with seating for two. Washer and dryer located within the unit. Amenities include an on-site gym and a common area courtyard with two gas grills. The unit comes with one reserved parking space along with open parking for an additional vehicle under the building. Easy access to downtown Stamford shops, restaurants, train station, I-95, Mill River Park and the Hart Magnet School which is located next door to the condo complex which is assigned to this elementary school.
